blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is strengthening its agricultural ties with Brazil and Canada as the government moves to expand export markets and secure additional farm products despite tightening local supply. “The discussions sought to advance two complementary priorities, namely, getting more Philippine farm and fishery products into overseas markets while maintaining reliable sources of imported […]...
